name: Branislav Jovanović
bio:
Branislav's journey into the world of motorsport began unconventionally. He initially trained as a fine artist, specializing in restoring antique furniture. It was his meticulous eye for detail and understanding of color layering that caught the attention of a local racing team needing someone to bring their classic Opala race cars back to their former glory. Branislav quickly adapted his skills, learning the intricacies of automotive paint and bodywork.

He approaches his role with a blend of artistic precision and engineering practicality. Branislav is renowned for his ability to perfectly match original paint codes and create custom finishes that are both aesthetically pleasing and aerodynamically sound. He believes in using cutting-edge techniques alongside traditional methods to ensure the highest quality results. Branislav's visionary approach to paint application and his relentless pursuit of perfection make him a highly sought-after specialist in the Opala Legends team.

physical.description: Branislav is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a pristine white lab coat, even when mixing paint.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Obsessively cleans his spray guns after each use, regardless of how busy he is.
